The station attendant helped me call the police and I made a report straight away. The next day I took a taxi to the US Consulate in Florence, had new passport photos taken and paid for an emergency passport so I could fly home. I am claiming for everything I lost and what the passport cost me.

summary: Skiing fall on the second day of the trip, with an injured wrist and a broken front tooth
story: On my second day skiing I caught an edge on a blue run and went down hard. I landed on my wrist and hit my face on the snow. One of my front teeth broke. The ski patrol took me down, and I went to the hospital in Sankt Felden, where they X-rayed my wrist and strapped it. That afternoon they sent me to a dentist in town. He saved the tooth and put a temporary crown on it, and he told me to get the permanent crown done at home. I flew home as planned and had the crown fitted by my own dentist on February 24. I am claiming the hospital bill, the dentist in Austria and the crown at home.

summary: Dislocated shoulder after falling off a rented jet ski
story: On August 7 I rented a jet ski for half an hour from a shop on the beach at Kalavria Bay. When I was signing the form, the man at the desk asked if I had extreme sports cover and said most travel policies don't pay for jet skis. I told him I had normal travel insurance and went out anyway. About twenty minutes in I hit a wake from a bigger boat, got thrown off and landed badly on my right arm. My shoulder had come out of place. The shop called a taxi and I went to the hospital in Poros town, where they put it back in and kept me overnight. A shoulder specialist saw me the next morning and I left with a sling and painkillers. I paid all the bills myself and I'm claiming them now. I'm worried after what the shop said.

The guide splinted it and I was taken to the hospital in Glacier Fork, where they said my shin bone was broken in two places. I had surgery that evening and stayed one night. I flew home on my original date with a cast and crutches. I am claiming the hospital bill, which I paid on my card before I left.

summary: Bag with phone, laptop and cash missing after driving between two hotels
story: On the morning of August 12 I checked out of the Albergo Corallina in Ravello Marina and loaded my rental car in front of the hotel. Then I drove about four hours to my next hotel in Castelbruno. When I unpacked there that evening, my small black shoulder bag was not in the car. It had my phone, my laptop and about $90 in cash in it. I think I either left it on the pavement by the hotel entrance while I was loading the car, or somebody took it while I was going back and forth. I did not report it to the police or call the first hotel. I didn't think there was any point, because I was hours away by then and I was sure nobody would hand in a phone and a laptop. I bought a cheap phone the next day so I could keep traveling. I would like to claim for the bag's contents.

story: On May 4 my sister Celia called to tell me her doctors had found her cancer had spread and that it is terminal. I was supposed to fly to Iceland on May 14 for a week. There was no way I could go, so I cancelled everything the next day to stay near her. The airline would not give me anything back for the flights. The hotel kept part of what I paid and gave me back $150 of the $360. The glacier tour refunded me in full. I am claiming the flights and the $210 the hotel kept.

The next boat I could get on left on August 12. I had to stay two more nights at a hotel near the harbor, and I am claiming those two nights.

summary: Return flight canceled after an air traffic control failure, home four days late
story: I was due to fly home from Athens on the morning of August 12. When I got to the airport the board showed my flight as canceled, and the airline staff said the air traffic control system had gone down and almost nothing was taking off. The next seat they could give me was on the evening of August 15, so I took a taxi back into the city and stayed at a small hotel for three nights. I ate my meals out and kept the receipts. On the 15th I took another taxi to the airport and I landed at home on August 16, four days later than planned. I am claiming the hotel, the meals and the two taxis.

summary: Couple cancelled a trip to Calvera, Italy two days before departure over a respiratory illness outbreak in the region
story: My wife and I were due to fly to Calvera on May 14 for eight days. Around the start of May the news started reporting a respiratory illness spreading in towns near Calvera, and the numbers kept going up every day. My wife has asthma and we are both in our sixties, so we were scared of catching it there and being stuck in a hospital far from home. On May 12 we decided we could not take the risk and cancelled. Neither of us was sick. The airline and the hotel both said our bookings were non-refundable, so we lost $1,720. We have paid for insurance for years and this is exactly the kind of thing we thought it was for.

summary: Cabin bag snatched at Valencia train station on the last day of the trip
story: On September 12, the day I was due to fly home, I was standing at the ticket machines in the main train station in Valencia with my cabin bag on my shoulder. A man on a scooter rode past, grabbed the strap and pulled it off me, and he was gone before I could do anything. The bag had my laptop, my camera and its lens, my tablet, three shirts and my passport in it. I reported it to the police at the station office within the hour. Then I went to the US consulate and got an emergency passport so I could still take my flight that night. I am claiming for everything in the bag and the passport fee.

summary: Trip to Costa Rica canceled after both passports could not be found at home three days before departure
story: We were flying to Costa Rica on May 22. On the evening of May 19 I went to get our passports out of the drawer where we always keep them, and they were not there. Renée's was gone too. We searched the whole house and the car and never found them. I called the passport agency the next morning but the earliest appointment they had was in June, so there was no way to travel. I canceled the flights and the resort that day. The airline and the resort would not give us anything back. We paid $1,900 for a trip we could not take, and I would like that covered.
